title: Data driven approach for Outdoor Channel Prediction in 5G and Beyond
abstract: arXiv:2605.01777v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: An evolution of Wireless Communications towards 5G and beyond provides improved user experience in terms of quality of services. Understanding and estimating Channel information plays crucial role in providing better user experience. Traditional methods of channel estimation involves periodically sending pilots (known signals), estimating channel and send back estimated channel information to the BS which increases computational complexity and communication complexity. Hence, we focus on data driven approach for channel estimation. In this work, we explore a channel estimation mechanism at 7GHz frequency band for a given user location. This work involves data generation using Ray tracing mechanism and Machine learning model training that contains feature variables such as transmitter location, user location and target variable as channel coefficient . We explored Support Vector Regression, K-nearest neighbor (KNN), Random Fores

translated_title: 5G及未来通信中室外信道预测的数据驱动方法
translated_abstract: 无线通信向5G及未来技术的演进在服务质量方面为用户提供了更好的体验。理解和估计信道信息在提供更佳用户体验方面起着至关重要的作用。传统的信道估计方法包括周期性地发送导频（已知信号）、估计信道并将估计的信道信息回传给基站，这增加了计算复杂度和通信复杂度。因此，我们专注于数据驱动的信道估计方法。在这项工作中，我们探索了在7GHz频段针对给定用户位置的信道估计机制。这项工作包括使用射线追踪机制生成数据，以及训练机器学习模型，该模型包含发射机位置、用户位置等特征变量，并以信道系数作为目标变量。我们探索了支持向量回归、K近邻（KNN）、随机森林等模型。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种数据驱动的室外信道预测方法，利用射线追踪生成数据并训练机器学习模型（支持向量回归、KNN、随机森林）在7GHz频段估计信道系数，从而避免了传统基于导频的信道估计方法带来的计算与通信复杂度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a data-driven approach for outdoor channel prediction at 7GHz by generating data via ray tracing and training machine learning models (Support Vector Regression, KNN, Random Forest), thereby avoiding the computational and communication complexity of traditional pilot-based channel estimation methods.
